title: Soft and Fluffy Scrambled Eggs
intro: My mother taught me how to make the best scrambled eggs in the world with a few tips and tricks to keep them soft and fluffy.

items: Serves one, double/triple the recipe for more people

method: In a saucepan, crack in both your eggs, add in the milk, butter and cheese slice and mix together.
Place the saucepan on the stove with the gas on the lowest setting.
Ensure you keep mixing the eggs while the cook. a high flame will not help you here.
Low and slow is the way to go.

Ingredients:
Serves one, double/triple the recipe for more people
-2 eggs
-1 . 5 tbsp milk
-2 tbsp butter
-1 cheese slice
-pinch of salt and pepper

Method:

-In a saucepan, crack in both your eggs, add in the milk, butter and cheese slice and mix together.
-Place the saucepan on the stove with the gas on the lowest setting. 
-Ensure you keep mixing the eggs while the cook. a high flame will not help you here.
low and slow is  the way to go. 
-When the eggs look almost done add in your salt and a nice pinch of pepper &
take them off the heat as they will keep cooking
-Serve them on fresh toast and enjoy!
